# Fixture corpus

Test data driving `tests/test_fixture_corpus.py` and (externally)
`tests/test_real_data_external.py`.

## Layout

```
fixtures/
├── manual_test/        18 .xlsx files curated for the CO app's manual upload flow
│                       (copied from ~/workspace/client/barry-CO-bom-data/local/manual-test-files/).
│                       Naming: NN-{client}-{module}-{scenario}.xlsx.
│                       Categories: 0X = Growatt catalog, 1X = Do Thanh BCCT,
│                                   2X = Growatt BOM, 30 = Johnson SAP BOM.
│                       Each ~5 KB; total ~95 KB.
│
└── edge_cases/         7 synthetic files generated by _generate.py to cover
                        hub-specific bugs and boundaries the manual files don't.
```

Re-generate the synthetics:

```bash
uv run python tests/fixtures/edge_cases/_generate.py
```

## What the corpus proves

`test_fixture_corpus.py` parametrizes over 26 cases: 19 pass + 7 xfail
documenting open bugs. When a bug is fixed, flip the corresponding `CASES`
entry from `{"xfail": "..."}` to a numeric expectation and re-run.

### Open bugs encoded as xfail

| Severity | Fixtures | Bug |
|---|---|---|
| **P1** | `growatt_technical_chinese_review/accept`, `edge_growatt_bom_chinese` | Chinese BOM headers (`成品物料/组件物料/标准用量/单位`) not aliased in `app/parsers/bom.py:COMMON_ALIASES`. |
| **P1** | `johnson_sap_leaf_only`, `edge_johnson_sap_english` | SAP English headers (`Component number`, `Comp. Qty (CUn)`, `Component unit`) not aliased in johnson profile. |
| **P1** | `growatt_dssp_full_no_hq` | SP-only catalog (no `Mã HQ` column) rejected by `materials.py`. Real DS SP files use `product_code` only. |
| **P0** | `edge_bom_uploaded_as_bcct` | BCCT parser falsely matches a BOM workbook (`Mã NVL` aliases to `customs_code`). Real Growatt 51MB BOM produces 197K junk rows when uploaded to the BCCT slot. Fix: tighten `bcct.py` gating to require both `declaration_no` AND a date column. |

### External-only (real `.xls` data, gated by `DATA_HUB_REAL_DATA_DIR`)

| Severity | Bug |
|---|---|
| **P0** | Legacy `.xls` format unsupported. openpyxl rejects all real Growatt BCCT (T3-T4 2026), DKE BCCT 2025, Do Thanh BCCT (E31/E62), and the bundled Danh Mục NPL/SP files. Fix: `xlrd` for `.xls` or in-flight `libreoffice --headless` conversion. |
| **P1** | Real Growatt 2025 BOM `.xlsm` opens but doesn't fit any of the 3 profiles. Likely needs a 4th profile or extension of `growatt_multi_workbook`. |

## Out of scope

`00-growatt-demo-input.xlsx` is a CO-app case workbook (4 sheets:
Case/Documents/Products/Materials). Data Hub has no concept of cases —
excluded from the corpus.

CO-app workflow concepts (full vs partial scope, Direct vs Technical BOM,
"accept review" flag, "retire missing products") aren't replicated in hub
today. The fixtures still parse, but the semantic outcomes (e.g. v2 version
created, status `inactive_pending_review`) belong to the routes layer, not
parsers — they'd be tested via httpx-driven route tests. See
`tests/test_bom_idempotency.py` for the existing pattern.

## Real-data tests

External fixtures live outside the repo. To run:

```bash
DATA_HUB_REAL_DATA_DIR=~/workspace/client/_real_test_corpus \
  uv run pytest tests/test_real_data_external.py -v
```

Expected directory layout is documented at the top of
`tests/test_real_data_external.py`. Tests skip cleanly when files are
missing.
